plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: bottle as the brand anchor on the left, a big 'Glow on.' in the middle, and a one-line 'SHOP SOLSTICE' CTA on the right with real breathing room from the edge.
Headline-first: 'Glow on.' leads large from the left edge, the bottle sits as a centre pivot, and the CTA closes the read on the right, so the order goes message, then product, then action.

A centred lockup that echoes the original's stacked composition: the bottle on the left of the group, with the headline stacked over a single-line CTA beside it, and even empty space on both sides of the cluster.
